newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico stocks continue slide on Dow Jones.
newsitem.headline: Mexico stocks continue slide on Dow Jones.

text.p: Mexican stocks extended their early slide at midday trade on Monday as a downturn on Wall Street weighed heavily on a thin-volume market, traders said.
"The market is apathetic, it is still weighed down by sellers and lack of news," a floor trader said. "Basically it's down on the Dow Jones and scant dealing by investors."
The leading IPC share index .MXX was down 46.29 points, or 1.23 percent, at 3,718.17. Volume .TV.MX was light at 37.5 million shares. The Dow Jones was meanwhile off 30.90 points at 6,360.79.
Technical analysts said the IPC was nearing support at 3,700 points.
"The Mexican stock market is still within a downward channel, after respecting resistance at 3,830 points," a weekly report by the Valmex brokerage said.

Traders noted that U.S. consumer price data coupled with expected hikes in interest rates at Banco de Mexico's weekly Treasury bill auction on Tuesday were "making waves" in the bourse and were also depressing trade.
